name: Effective Range / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
proof: Every coordinate projection has at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\) active coordinates. In every nonempty subfamily of such a projection, the full active-coordinate sample teaches any chosen concept, so each recursive teaching stage has a teaching set of size at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\). Taking the maximum over projections proves the bound.
witness_verification: For $n$ singleton concepts, effective range is $n$ while monotone recursive teaching dimension is 1.
